# noether v2.0.0 - Table of Contents

Algebra utilities for Elixir

## Modules

- [Noether](https://noether.hexdocs.pm/Noether.md): Noether aims to ease common data manipulation tasks by introducing simple algebraic functions and other utilities.
Functions and names are inspired (sometimes taken as-is) from Haskell.
- [Noether.Either](https://noether.hexdocs.pm/Noether.Either.md): This module hosts several utility functions to work with `{:ok, _} | {:error, _}` values.
These type of values will be then called `Either`.

- [Noether.List](https://noether.hexdocs.pm/Noether.List.md): This module hosts several utility functions to work with lists,
including sequential validation and recursive list building.

- [Noether.Maybe](https://noether.hexdocs.pm/Noether.Maybe.md): This module hosts several utility functions to work with nullable values.
A `nil` value represents the absence of a result, similar to Haskell's `Nothing`.

- [Noether.Try](https://noether.hexdocs.pm/Noether.Try.md): This module hosts several utility functions to work with `{:ok, _} | {:error, _}` values.
